thread_title: Struggling with hard mode chapter 5 Boss
Struggling with hard mode chapter 5 Boss

content:
I have decided to pull only on Aequor because:

* I get Awakeners to PS+12 more quickly. I can then use Origins of Time on fully upgraded Awakeners to get the maximum number of Protoparadises, which I can use to obtain or upgrade base Awakeners from any realm.
* Once I have Awakeners at PS+12, I can also choose to leave them there and keep pulling duplicates, which gives me Soul Rewind Shards. 10 of those -> 1 SSR Awakener selector.

Meanwhile, I can still get SSRs from event pulls.
